title: Record that the published E8 minors are half-integer units
body:
## Summary
- The scaled E8 model has 120 roots, 192 pair profiles, and 100 forbidden profiles.
- Each of the 109 published 8×8 minors has determinant ±256, ±512, ±1024, or ±2048, so each is a unit over the half-integers.
- The selected κ is unchanged.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/e8-minor-units/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/e8-minor-units/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/e8-minor-units`
- [ ] Maintainer replay from the pinned base commit
